difficulty_reason: For a morphism of presheaves F -> G surjective after sheafification, compute the simplicial homology of the nerve K with n-simplices the (n+1)-fold fibre product of F over G: at each U, with A = F(U) and B = G'(U) the image, K(U) -> B is a trivial Kan fibration (simplicial-lemma-cosk-minus-one-equivalence) hence a homotopy equivalence, so Z_K(U) -> Z_B is a homotopy equivalence after applying free abelian groups; the normalized complex of the constant simplicial abelian group Z_B is the Eilenberg-MacLane complex with differentials 0,1,0,1,... giving H_i = 0 for i > 0 and H_0 = oplus_{b in B} Z (simplicial-lemma-homology-eilenberg-maclane); these identifications are compatible with restriction maps, and exactness of sheafification yields H_i(s(Z_K))^# and H_0 = Z_{G'}^# = Z_G^#.
